title: Measurement Source Type
description: Collection mechanism a count is built from — what was observed and how. Not who observed it (a BrandRef carries the party), how an outcome was attributed (`attribution_methodology`), or the maturation or IVT stage (`measurement_window`). Neutral, not a quality ranking. Shared by `billing_measurement.counting_sources[]` and `measurement_provenance.source_types[]`. Broadcast as-run logs and station affidavits are airing evidence (proof that a spot ran), not a counting source for audience measurement, so they are not values; delivery reports carry as-run data in `by_spot[]`, separately from audience rows. Ownership labels are not values: ad-server and publisher logs are both `server_logs`. Released values cannot be renamed or removed.

enumDescriptions.set_top_box: Set-top-box return-path tuning events from cable, satellite, or IPTV devices.
enumDescriptions.acr: Automatic content recognition from smart TVs or companion devices.
enumDescriptions.panel: Recruited respondent panel (meter or diary) projected to a population.
enumDescriptions.server_logs: Events observed server-side in the decision or delivery path (ad server, SSAI stitcher, publisher backend), including tracking URLs a server fires on the player's behalf. Not a render confirmation.
enumDescriptions.client_tracker: Declarative tracking URLs (pixels, beacons, VAST/DAAST tracking URLs) requested by the player or browser; no measurement code executes. Server-fired URLs are `server_logs`; executing code is `sdk`.
enumDescriptions.sdk: Measurement code executing in the player, app, or page (OM SDK, vendor JavaScript tags, mobile and CTV SDKs).
